citep.title: Cite this view
citep.lead: Ready to paste: the figure, its source, the date of the data and a link that always shows this exact version.
citep.steps: {n, plural, one {The # processing step} other {All # processing steps}}
citep.autoNote: The counts were read from the notice text by a program. Open the original notice and check the figure before you publish it.
citep.check: Cite the original source for the number and this site as where you obtained it. Sources revise their figures; the link above keeps showing the version you saw.
citep.stmt.global: {disease}, {period}: {value}. {metric}, summed over the {n} of {N} countries that reported for that period.
citep.stmt.globalNoN: {disease}, {period}: {value}. {metric}, summed over the countries that reported for that period.
citep.stmt.eventNone: {head}: {n, plural, one {# official notice} other {# official notices}} between {first} and {last}. No case count is quoted here.
feed.title: Follow by feed
feed.what: Atom format, for any feed reader. Refreshed when the site updates; not an alerting service.
evtl.title: {n, plural, one {Timeline of # event} other {Timeline of # events}}
evtl.means: Each bar runs from an event’s first official notice to its latest one, over at most the last two years. It shows when notices were published, not how large an event is.
evtl.first: The first {n} of {total} listed events are drawn.
evtl.row: {label}: {n, plural, one {# notice} other {# notices}}, first on {first}, latest on {last}
diff.order: The earlier snapshot is later than the later one. Swap them to see changes in the usual direction.
evdiff.title: Outbreak events that changed
evdiff.lead: Events that first appeared, or whose status, stated counts, notices or countries differ, between the two dates.
evdiff.count: {n, plural, =0 {No event differs} one {# event differs} other {# events differ}}
evdiff.note: Each cell shows status · stated cases / stated deaths · number of notices · countries named. Counts are read automatically from notice text; a change can also mean the reading was corrected.
map.kbd.hint: Keyboard: arrow keys move between countries, a letter jumps to a country by name, Enter opens it.
plain.publishedOn: The latest notice was published on {date}. You are looking at the version this site saved on {snapshot}.
